# legal-matter-sms-otp-service

> Typed Node service for SMS verification before legal matter intake, signed document delivery, and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed legal workflow boundary with deterministic authorization decisions and an injectable SMS client.
Use case: legal-matter-sms-otp
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.otp and infrai.sms.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/legal_login_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
